snippet.title: Gas Station Simulator: RV Camp DLC | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Gas Station Simulator: RV Camp DLC – Become the ultimate campground manager! Join Ruby to transform a quiet patch of land into a thriving RV resort. Rent out RV spots, play fun minigames, manage guests, expand your campsite, and turn Ruby’s dream into the most legendary vacation destination on Route 66! 🏕️
________________________________________
👉 Play GSS: RV Camp DLC now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543920/Gas_Station_Simulator__RV_Camp_DLC/
________________________________________
⚠️ Key Features:
👵 Join Forces with Ruby: Help bring her dream resort to life.
🚐 Welcome RV Travelers: Rent out spots and meet a wide variety of guests.
🎮 Minigames Galore: Solve guest problems through fun and diverse gameplay.
🔧 Expand & Upgrade: Unlock new campsite features and hire staff to keep things running.
🌟 Build Your Reputation: The better the experience, the more popular your campground becomes!
🧱 Requirements: Base game required to play.
